parameters.name: NewResourceGroupId
parameters.description: The ID of the new resource group. You can view available resource groups in the resource group console.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description:
The region where the WAF instance resides. Valid values:

- **cn-hangzhou**: the Chinese mainland.

- **ap-southeast-1**: outside the Chinese mainland.

parameters.name: ResourceId
parameters.description: The ID of the WAF resource to operate on.

parameters.name: ResourceManagerResourceGroupId
parameters.description: The Alibaba Cloud resource group ID.

parameters.name: ResourceType
parameters.description: The resource type. Fixed value: defenseresource.
